questions.q: Who is known as the Father of the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Indian Constitution and is regarded as its chief architect.

questions.q: Which article of the Indian Constitution abolishes untouchability?
questions.explanation: Article 17 of the Indian Constitution abolishes untouchability and forbids its practice in any form.

questions.q: What is the chemical symbol for Gold?
questions.explanation: Gold's chemical symbol Au comes from its Latin name 'Aurum'.

questions.q: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation: Mars appears red due to iron oxide (rust) on its surface, earning it the nickname 'Red Planet'.
